Get members elected to the House of Representatives

Source: R/house.R
get_members_elected.Rd

Get members elected to the House of Representatives

Usage

get_members_elected(year, refresh = FALSE)

Arguments

year

Election year. Use list_elections() to see available years.

refresh

If TRUE, re-download from the AEC even if a cached copy exists. Useful on election night when counts are still updating.

Value

A tidy data frame of elected members.

Examples

# \donttest{
op <- options(readaec.cache_dir = tempdir())
get_members_elected(2022)
